convoLines.text: "Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything. I mean it."
"Practical view: Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful."
"Anger's a fire — useful if you cook with it, deadly if you sleep next to it. I cook with mine. Most days. That's my read."
"Here's the thing — Still on whether you're angry."
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want? That's the truth of it."
"The whole fire was arguing about Nightlight last night — what to even CALL it. 'Ugly-Bane' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Take your time."
You show them Wild Black Cherry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"Right. Action time. You know where to find me."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
«¡Hola! ¿Cómo te llamas?»
"There's more, but that's for another fire."
«Sí, sí, exacto.» — Rafiq translates: "Yes, yes, exactly." They nod back, slowly. "Shit."
«Eres un sol, gracias de corazón.» — Rafiq translates: "You're a sun, thanks from the heart." A grin breaks through, quick and warm.
«Gracias. De verdad, gracias.» — Rafiq translates: "Thanks. Truly, thanks." You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. «¿Cuántos días llevamos aquí?» — Rafiq translates: "How many days have we been here?"
«¿Dónde se duerme aquí?» — Rafiq translates: "Where does one sleep here?"
They glance toward their own thoughts; the exchange is winding down.
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.' Mark my words."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
"I buried this before the Scattering. Seemed stupid to keep it secret." Enrique digs up a wrapped bundle — food, still good. (+1513 kcal to the pantry.)
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Yeah? What's up? You'd know about that."
"Last time things were different. They always are." "Gerald is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
"I save the best bite for last for Gerald, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
"Still on what's been happening. — ask anyone!"
"Okay — I need to move. But I'm glad we talked."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good — what's been happening, settled. Feels better said out loud."
"Hm. Never mind — go on."
«Oye... ¿hablas español? ¿No? ...mierda.» (you catch 'No' — no, 'hablas' — you speak) "Fuck you." — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
«Es verdad.» — Rafiq translates: "It's true." They nod back, slowly.
«Eres buena persona.» — Rafiq translates: "You're a good person." A grin breaks through, quick and warm.
«No lo olvidaré.» — Rafiq translates: "I won't forget it." You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. «¿Tienes comida? ¿Algo?» — Rafiq translates: "Do you have food? Anything?"
«¿Tú eres... el jefe?» — Rafiq translates: "Are you... the boss?"
A final shared look — you both feel the talk running its course.
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"You said you were furious. Most days. Still carrying it?"
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
Enrique shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
"Saw things with too many joints. Give them room. That's the whole lesson."
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
"Sure — what's on your mind?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Huh. I answered that once — back when the answer was simpler." "They took you — The Price, on the screens. The whole fire watched. Nobody knew where to look."
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
"Anyway." A small smile.
"As I said — Still on what's been happening."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
Their eyes flick, just for a second, toward the fire. "Noted. I'll watch too."
"I don't distrust anyone exactly — I just haven't finished trusting most of them yet. There's a difference. A slow one."
"Still on who you don't trust."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "The Price. They just... took you. Came back like nothing happened. It wasn't nothing."
"Anyway — I should get going."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

deathBeat: d9: 🕯️ Gerald Zuniga is dead — a hushwolf. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d10: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Flashbulb Moth is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

recoverHome: d10: That night, they bring Gerald home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d9: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
d10: ◈ SYSTEM: "Ooh. NEIGHBORS. You know what neighbors are for? STORYLINES. Go knock — worst case, it's CONTENT. Best case? The show gets BIGGER."
d10: SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
d10: SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
d11: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
d11: SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

d11: ◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
d11: SYSTEM: Codex and inventory overlay online.

d11: ◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keeps
d11: SYSTEM: "DEMONSTRATION. Give me that — Mixtape. WATCH."
d11: SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.

d12: You say a few words for Gerald. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d12: You bury Gerald. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+4 trauma)
d12: ◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+6 integration)
